'''Davis Joness''' was an administrator of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] government before the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the establishment of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], he was unable to cope with the new Imperial regulations and was demoted to waste collector. He eventually aided [[Keets Freely]] and [[Fy-Tor-Ana|Solace]] in rescuing [[Ferus Olin]].
